&Options = new()

LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_EXTRUSIONEXTRUSORANOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadExtrusionExtrusoraNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_BOBINANOSERIE'
		Do 'LoadBobinaNoSerieOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"admin.ImprimirBobinasGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"admin.ImprimirBobinasGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"admin.ImprimirBobinasGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSIONEXTRUSORANOMBRE"
				&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSIONEXTRUSORANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFEXTRUSIONFECHA"
				&TFExtrusionFecha.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFExtrusionFecha_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINANOSERIE"
				&TFBobinaNoSerie.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINANOSERIE_SEL"
				&TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAORIGEN_SEL"
				&TFBobinaOrigen_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFBobinaOrigen_Sels.FromJson(&TFBobinaOrigen_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAHORAINICIO"
				&TFBobinaHoraInicio.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFBobinaHoraInicio_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAHORASALIDA"
				&TFBobinaHoraSalida.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFBOBINAESTADO_SEL"
				&TFBobinaEstado_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFBobinaEstado_Sels.FromJson(&TFBobinaEstado_SelsJson)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadExtrusionExtrusoraNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each
		Order ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre
		Where (ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre like !'%' + &FilterFullText) OR (BobinaNoSerie like !'%' + &FilterFullText) OR ("a" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaOrigen = !"A") OR ("b" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaOrigen = !"B") OR ("en proceso" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"En Proceso") OR ("en medición" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"En Medición") OR ("reposo" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Reposo") OR ("molino" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Molino") OR ("disponible" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Disponible") OR ("en prensado" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"En Prensado") OR ("pausada" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Pausada") OR ("desmontada" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Desmontada") OR ("transferida" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Transferida") OR ("rechazada" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Rechazada") OR ("consumida" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND BobinaEstado = !"Consumida") OR (BobinaDesviacionEstandar.ToString() like !'%' + &FilterFullText) When not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		Where ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre like &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre when &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel.IsEmpty() AND (not &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.IsEmpty())
		Where ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre = &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel when not &TFExtrusionExtrusoraNombre_Sel.IsEmpty()
		Where ExtrusionFecha >= &TFExtrusionFecha when not &TFExtrusionFecha.IsEmpty()
		Where ExtrusionFecha <= &TFExtrusionFecha_To when not &TFExtrusionFecha_To.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaNoSerie like &TFBobinaNoSerie when &TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel.IsEmpty() AND (not &TFBobinaNoSerie.IsEmpty())
		Where BobinaNoSerie = &TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel when not &TFBobinaNoSerie_Sel.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaOrigen in &TFBobinaOrigen_Sels when &TFBobinaOrigen_Sels.Count > 0
		Where BobinaHoraInicio >= &TFBobinaHoraInicio when not &TFBobinaHoraInicio.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaHoraInicio <= &TFBobinaHoraInicio_To when not &TFBobinaHoraInicio_To.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaHoraSalida >= &TFBobinaHoraSalida when not &TFBobinaHoraSalida.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaHoraSalida <= &TFBobinaHoraSalida_To when not &TFBobinaHoraSalida_To.IsEmpty()
		Where BobinaEstado in &TFBobinaEstado_Sels when &TFBobinaEstado_Sels.Count > 0

		&count = 0
		For Each
			Order ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = ExtrusionExtrusoraNombre
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub
